title: Hard-coded URL in Calculation
description: Security / maintainability rule — calculation chunks with a literal http(s):// URL. Hard-coded endpoints are brittle and leak infrastructure.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Hard-coded URLs break when infrastructure moves and expose internal endpoints in the DDR.
rule.remediation: Move the base URL into a settings field / global so it can change without editing calculations.
